verdicts.proof: Old rule confirmed at 70a94933 moto_detail_page.dart:225-232 (ValidationBanner when dates chosen) and :627-648 (REZERVOVAT enabled only by _selStart != null). Important nuance: in the old look the banner was a WARNING only - REZERVOVAT stayed enabled with banner errors; the hard stop was the booking form: booking_form_widget.dart:548-554 canProceed requires err == null (bookingValidationErrorProvider = licence ?? overlap ?? rental length ?? lead time, booking_provider.dart:299-304) and profileErr == null. v2 entry points to /booking from Domu/search: (a) v2 bike detail - shows ValidationBanner (detail_trip_card_v2.dart:191) then startBookingFromSelection; (b) calculator - ValidationBanner at calc_step_dates_v2.dart:108, book() at calc_body_v2.dart:148; (c) NEW Home funnel REZERVOVAT -> startBookingFromSelection (home_funnel_v2.dart:216) -> booking_entry.dart:88-90 pushes /booking directly, WITHOUT any ValidationBanner. On every path the v2 form keeps the hard stop: canProceed: canProceedNow() && !rangeBusy (booking_form_widget.dart:582) and err/errKind are passed to BookingFormV2View, which shows BookingWarningsV2 with fix actions (booking_form_view_v2.dart:263-272, actions :149-156) and a dock blocker text v2BkBlockError (:171). So nothing is bypassed, but path (c) loses the early warning. Concrete customer path: logged-in customer whose profile has NO licence groups -> homeLicenseGroups empty -> homeEligibleMotos does not filter licence (funnel_provider.dart:120) and the badge shows nothing -> taps REZERVOVAT on a bike needing A2 -> lands in the form and only there sees the licence error (checkLicense returns validationNoLicense for empty groups, booking_validator.dart:32-35). Same for an unpaid/pending own booking overlapping the funnel weekend (funnel only hides itself for PAID active bookings, home_screen_v2.dart:98) and for a bike with min_rental_days above the 2-3 day weekend. Server: overlap and closed branch yes (trg_check_booking_overlap, trg_check_user_booking_overlap, trg_check_booking_branch_open); licence on new booking and min/max days not found server-side.

No old equivalent (owner-requested V21 #3). funnel_provider.dart:108-133 homeEligibleMotos excludes closed branches, trailers, kids' bikes unless a kids' booking was completed, and licence-ineligible bikes via BookingValidator.checkLicense when the profile has groups; funnelCandidatesProvider (:149-165) uses motorcyclesProvider (status filter) and the same motoAvailableForRange as the catalogue date filter (catalog_provider.dart:420-421). The only gap (no pre-form licence/overlap warning on its REZERVOVAT) is recorded under G-102; the form still blocks.
